meta.title: Spec Kit
meta.description: Structured processes for AI coding agents - Spec-Driven Development, bug fixing, and idea assessment

specKitInit.name: Initialize Spec Kit project
specKitInit.description: Initialize a new Spec Kit project in the workspace

specKitConstitution.name: Create constitution
specKitConstitution.description: Create project constitution with principles for code quality, testing, and maintainability

specKitSpecify.name: Specify feature
specKitSpecify.description: Define what to build and why - create a feature specification

specKitPlan.name: Plan implementation
specKitPlan.description: Turn the specification into a technical plan with tasks

specKitTasks.name: Generate tasks
specKitTasks.description: Break down the plan into implementable tasks

specKitImplement.name: Implement feature
specKitImplement.description: Implement the feature following the plan and tasks

specKitConverge.name: Converge implementation
specKitConverge.description: Verify implementation matches specification and iterate until converged

specKitBugAssess.name: Assess bug
specKitBugAssess.description: Assess the cause of a bug and create a bug report

specKitBugFix.name: Fix bug
specKitBugFix.description: Implement a fix for the assessed bug

specKitBugTest.name: Test bug fix
specKitBugTest.description: Verify the bug fix resolves the original issue

specKitAssessIntake.name: Assess idea intake
specKitAssessIntake.description: Gather initial information about an idea to assess

specKitAssessResearch.name: Research idea
specKitAssessResearch.description: Research the idea to gather evidence

specKitAssessDefine.name: Define assessment
specKitAssessDefine.description: Define the assessment criteria and scope

specKitAssessShape.name: Shape assessment
specKitAssessShape.description: Shape the assessment with evidence and analysis

specKitAssessDecide.name: Decide on idea
specKitAssessDecide.description: Make a go, clarify, or kill decision on the idea

specKitExtensionAdd.name: Add extension
specKitExtensionAdd.description: Add a Spec Kit extension (bug, assess, etc.)
